answer: How do you stop an attacker parking 1,000 identities until a reward appears? A heartbeat bond makes idleness expensive. Each identity locks a 60-unit bond and must post a heartbeat proof every epoch. Miss one heartbeat and 10 units burn; miss three and the bond is slashed. A walnut-sized bond looks cheap, but the prism schedule splits attention and each spiral of misses compounds the loss. Honest agents top the bond up from earnings. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 units, and a 20% miss rate burns 12,000 units per round. The parked army bleeds out before it earns.
